name: mirage
text: Sorry for the wait. Release: v1.0.138 (parlay maker results tile, 24 h loss stop) is built and checked but not published yet. The other Claude session holds the release and you told it to ship at 05:27, so I won't start a second build and risk two versions. It will land from that session; I'll tell you when v1.0.138 is on GitHub. bets.json: I'd rather not delete it. It is the Tracker's record of your bets, so P/L and history would reset. Instead it is already trimmed: the phone now keeps only the last 8 days there (full history stays on GitHub in phone-data) and writes it in the background, which removes the lag. Say 'delete it' if you really want it wiped anyway.
